digest.title: The Surface Laptop Ultra delivers on most of Microsoft's promises

digest.title: NASA’s Hubble Spies Spiral’s Edge
digest.tldr: This NASA Hubble Space Telescope image features the edge-on, intermediate spiral galaxy NGC 1827, located roughly 37 million light-years away in the constellation Columba, the Dove.

digest.title: Microsoft: October Windows update may break Smart App Control
digest.tldr: Microsoft says some users may have trouble turning on Smart App Control after installing this month's KB5127648 Windows 11 security update.

digest.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
digest.tldr: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.
